_comment: Example Hermes Agent cron jobs for the OCR pipeline. Sanitized from a working setup; review before use. Replace every <...> placeholder. Create the jobs with Hermes's cron tool or CLI using these fields; ids, timestamps and run state are filled in by Hermes. Scripts are looked up by file name in the Hermes scripts folder ($HERMES_HOME/scripts/); copy or symlink scripts/ocr/mech.py and scripts/ocr/monitor.py there under these names, with ocr-pipeline.json next to them.

jobs.name: OCR pipeline mechanics
jobs._comment: No AI. Empty stdout sends nothing; any printed text is a notice delivered to 'deliver'. Do not name the script with, or put in its text, the word that Hermes's gateway-lifecycle guard rejects (see docs/scheduling.md).

jobs.name: OCR pipeline agent
jobs._comment: Runs only when the monitor's output changes. The monitor output is injected into the prompt. Pin a capable model (set model/provider) so the job does not follow a changing default.
jobs.prompt: Run one tick of the OCR roadmap pipeline. Read and follow <path-to-this-repo>/agents/ocr-pipeline-agent.md exactly. The monitor output in this prompt says whether there is work (idle means reply idle and stop). Settings (OCR_BASE_DIR, OCR_PIPELINE_DIR, FIXES_DIR) are in <path-to>/ocr-pipeline.json.

jobs.name: Coach watch
jobs._comment: No AI. Starts the Coach (COACH_CMD) while any loop agent works and for COOLDOWN_MIN after; prints nothing unless it started one. Set STATE_DIR, COACH_CMD and WATCH_FILES in the job environment. Copy scripts/coach/watch.py to the Hermes scripts folder as coach_watch.py.
